instruction: I want to enable animations in the desktop interface for a smoother experience. Can you turn this on?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling desktop animations. Evaluator verifies the enable-animations setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations' to retrieve the animation setting state
Metric comparison logic is appropriate: uses exact_match to verify the boolean setting value
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement from the instruction (enable animations)
Expected value is semantically correct: 'true\n' matches the actual gsettings output format when animations are enabled
No state timing issues: gsettings values are persistent and immediately queryable without need for postconfig
Data flow is correct: getter extracts setting state -> metric compares with expected 'true\n' -> verification succeeds when animations are enabled
